Triage: **`domain:cli` · type Bug · `pm:queue` · `target:v17` · `priority:p0`.** This is the first p0 and the first release-board entry this seat has set in days, so both are justified explicitly below rather than asserted.

**Routing, measured not guessed.** The ingestion door the fix has to run at is `packages/cli/src/utils/artifact-boot-migration.ts` — located by search, with its consumer at `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` and two existing self-tests beside it. `packages/cli` is `domain:cli` by the lane table. The other two files the card names are **reference, not landing surface**: `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` already declares the `allowRestore`/`allowPurge` stripKeys conversion (⇒ ⛔ no spec change expected), and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is the *model to copy* — the stored-row read path that already applies conversions.

⚠️ **Two boundaries the dev must stop at rather than cross quietly:**
- If "one policy, not per-door copies" turns out to require changing `packages/metadata-protocol` (engine lane) rather than just calling into it, that is a **cross-domain PR** — declare the full file surface in the claim and take the cross-domain exception path, ⛔ don't widen silently.
- If it turns out to need a `packages/spec/src/**` change after all, **Clause-② fires on the path leg** and it is not enqueueable below the contract-review tier. Expected not to, but check the diff rather than the plan.

**Why `priority:p0`** — the binary question is not "is it severe" but "is it live", and it is:
- `packages/spec` **17.2.0 is published**, not pending: objectui's `packages/core` depends on `"^17.2.0"` and resolves it. So the breaking runtime is already out.
- The removal shipped **inside the v17 line** (17.1.0 → 17.2.0). Every artifact already built by released tooling becomes unbootable the moment a deployment's runtime moves to ≥17.2 — hotcrm@main at its pinned `@objectstack/cli` 17.1.0 emits **75** occurrences of keys its own source contains **zero** of, because the released builder injects them.
- ⛔ **No operator action exists.** `os migrate meta` targets sources, not built artifacts; the only unblock found was hand-editing artifact JSON.
- Cloud's **own acceptance builds at its pin** are affected.

⇒ Live, released-surface, no workaround, self-inflicted by our own release. That is what p0 is for. ⛔ p0 does not exempt the same-file serial queue or the claim protocol.

**`target:v17`** — three of the four blocking classes are met, not one: ① a defect users hit today on the released surface; ③ already-built artifacts in the wild, unreachable by any migration tool we ship; ④ unambiguously an apology in the release notes. The epic-#12150 line's own "smooth upgrade for existing installs" promise is the thing that breaks.

**Scope note that should shape the fix — read #1883 before choosing strip-vs-convert.** #12497 retired these keys with the **M2 anchor left open: the keys return with M2** (#1883, `pm:on-hold`). So the conversion must be a *versioned forward conversion keyed off the artifact's authored `specVersion`*, ⛔ not an unconditional strip — an unconditional strip becomes wrong again the moment M2 lands and the keys are legal once more. The card's own suggested shape says this ("the artifact carries its authored `specVersion`/protocol handshake, so 'older 17.x, convert forward' is decidable"); the M2 return is the reason it is load-bearing rather than stylistic.

**Cross-repo half, recorded not filed**: cloud's composed-artifact path (`OS_COMPOSED_ARTIFACT_URL`) needs the same treatment and is a second door. ⛔ Not filed by this seat — cloud is outside this session's repo scope, and by the standing rule the consuming-side follow-up is filed by the seat that accepts this PR. Whoever does that should file it in cloud with a `Blocked-by:` pointing here, since the framework parse is the shared policy the cloud door should consume rather than reimplement.

**Repro is cheap and stated**: build hotcrm at its released toolchain, boot on current main via either artifact door. The workaround already run (stripping the two keys from an artifact copy → boot succeeds, full multi-org battery passes) is a **positive control proving the conversion is sufficient**, which is what makes this a queue card rather than an investigation.

Dedup run over the retired-key / artifact-conversion family: no twin. #12497 (closed) is the retirement that caused it; #1883 is the M2 project that will reverse it.

Review of record — PM ACCEPT + clause-② contract review PASS, both for [PR #12843](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12843) at head `6d097a6`.

The clause-② path limb did NOT fire (zero `packages/spec` changes — the registry is consumed, not extended); the content limb (previously-refused 17.x artifacts now accepted) is what this review covers, read from the diff:

- The acceptance widening is exactly the triage-ruled shape: a **versioned** window keyed off the artifact's declared `engines.protocol` floor vs the running spec (full `x.y.z`). Floor < runtime → full ADR-0087 chain replay (retired entries included) before the strict parse; floor ≥ runtime → nothing replayed, tombstones stay the authority (**pinned**: a current-version manifest with the same keys still refuses, and the pin asserts the tombstone's prescription text verbatim, not a bare throw); undeclared range → replay (stored-row posture); unresolvable runtime version → window closed. The M2 return case (#1883) is structurally protected — artifacts authored at ≥ the retirement version are never stripped by history.
- One policy, one authority: `applyArtifactForwardConversions` lives in `metadata-core` (spec-only dependency, deliberately consumable by cloud's composed door), the ADR-0087 registry in spec remains the sole conversion table, and the door (`MetadataPlugin._parseAndRegisterArtifact`) is the single funnel all framework artifact doors share — measured, not assumed (the triage's `packages/cli` routing was a located neighbour; the dev's producer-side landing is evidenced by the main-vs-branch boot control and is accepted as the real landing zone; noted: the landing packages sit in the engine lane while the card is routed `domain:cli` — recorded here as the sanctioned producer-side deviation).
- Notices are surfaced operator-visibly and deduped (one summary per conversion per artifact; the real artifact converts 150 sites).

**PM checklist**: draft ✓ base `main` ✓ `Fixes #12772` first line, no stray closure keywords ✓ 8 files = the report's list; changeset present ✓ no `content/docs/releases/` edits ✓ real derived fixture with a premise-guard pin (75+75 occurrences) ✓ end-to-end positive control (real 17.1-built hotcrm artifact: refuses on main `f75a38a`, boots clean on the branch with one summary line, exit 0) ✓ both stop boundaries held (zero spec, zero metadata-protocol; the one adjacent edit is an `export` keyword on `resolveDeclaredRange` in metadata-core's own handshake) ✓ out-of-scope finding filed as #12844 (AppPlugin raw-bundle `registerInMemory` second reader — measured non-defect today, graded for triage).

**Landing**: waits on full CI green on `6d097a6`; on green this seat flips ready → merge queue (clause-② enqueue gate satisfied: dispatched AND reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). **State of the PR, so the next tier-eligible seat starts from facts, not a re-derivation:**
